scripts.db:migrate:diff: bun run scripts/atlas.ts migrate diff --env local
scripts.db:migrate:deploy: bun run scripts/atlas.ts migrate apply --env local
scripts.db:migrate:status: bun run scripts/atlas.ts migrate status --env local
scripts.db:migrate:lint: bun run scripts/atlas.ts migrate lint --env local --latest 1
scripts.db:schema:drift: bun run scripts/atlas.ts schema diff --env local --from env://url --to env://src
scripts.db:kysely:codegen: bun --env-file=../../apps/web/.env.local --env-file=../../apps/web/.env run kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --default-schema public --include-pattern 'public.*' --out-file src/database/kysely/types.ts
scripts.db:kysely:verify: bun --env-file=../../apps/web/.env.local --env-file=../../apps/web/.env run kysely-codegen --dialect postgres --default-schema public --include-pattern 'public.*' --out-file src/database/kysely/types.ts --verify
